training_provenance: Upstream reports teacher pseudo-labels and reviewed RGB palm photos scraped from Reddit. Source photos and teacher weights are not included upstream. No new user-photo training or scraping performed here.
preprocessing: RGB, NCHW, ImageNet normalization. Full rotated landmark bbox + 100 source pixels, mirror to MediaPipe Left, teacher-style 1024 letterbox then 512. See upstream pipeline/hand_preprocess.py and generate_pseudo_labels.py, not just the generic palm-crop README.
limitations: Experimental segmentation candidate. Model probabilities are not calibrated accuracy. Public examples are developer-supplied, not independent held-out app evaluation. No claimed accuracy percentage. Poor images may return no lines. Physical iOS/Android testing remains necessary.
